reader_summary.headline: In the last episode of 2015, Ben and David discuss Apple's acquisition of Siri.
reader_summary.overview: In the last episode of 2015, Ben and David discuss Apple's acquisition of Siri. Notable topics include: The founding of Siri by Dag Kittlau, Adam Cheyer, and Chris Brigham. Scott Forstall on the Apple side, and the end of his time at the company.

key_points.text: The other Apple acquisitions around Siri, including Topsy, Novauris Technologies, OttoCat.
The team Apple built around Siri post-acquisition, including Alex Acero from Microsoft Research.
